# Energy Johnson

> Energy Johnson Concierge is the private client brand of Johnson Collective FZ-LLC. Its primary focus is luxury real estate in Dubai, relocation support, and private jet and yacht bookings, delivered with personal guidance and thoughtful coordination.

## Core services

- **Dubai real estate:** Support for clients looking to buy or rent luxury property in Dubai, including off-plan opportunities and completed homes already available on the market. Searches are tailored to preferred locations, lifestyle, property type and budget.
- **Relocation to Dubai:** Personal guidance for individuals, families and businesses moving to Dubai, including home search, school options, household staffing introductions and settling-in support.
- **Private concierge and travel:** Private jet and yacht bookings, considered holiday packages, and additional arrangements on request.
- **Private wellness retreats:** An occasional, limited offering reserved for a select circle of Energy Johnson's top clients. Retreats bring together wellness, boxing, strength, mobility, restorative time and destination dining.

## Fees and provider payments

For most holiday arrangements and private jet, yacht and venue bookings, Energy Johnson does not charge clients a separate booking fee. Where partner commissions apply, they are paid by the relevant provider. Clients pay the selected hotel, restaurant, venue, yacht, aviation provider or other supplier directly.

Some specific events or bespoke services may require an organisation fee or payment to Energy Johnson. Any such fee is explained and agreed with the client in advance before work begins. Energy Johnson coordinates introductions through a carefully selected network of experienced providers; availability, terms and third-party charges are confirmed by each provider.

## Relocation support after a property purchase

Clients who purchase a property through Energy Johnson receive personal relocation guidance at no additional Energy Johnson fee. This can include a tailored community brochure, an explanation of key points about the area, and introductions to experienced independent specialists for school options and admissions, private staffing, company set-up and other settling-in needs. School admission, third-party services and provider fees are subject to each provider's criteria, availability and charges; clients pay those providers directly. Clients who purchase elsewhere may discuss a bespoke relocation package, with any Energy Johnson fee agreed in advance.

## Approach

Clients have a personal point of contact from the first enquiry through the arrangements they request. Energy Johnson helps clients feel welcome in a new country or community and coordinates appropriate introductions through its network of property, relocation and lifestyle specialists.

## Retreat destinations

Preferred retreat destinations include Marbella in summer, Bali, Finland and St. Moritz in winter, and Oman. Retreat invitations and itineraries are shared privately as they are confirmed.
